title: ROAM-GRPO: Enforcing Reasoning Diversity in GRPO via Routed Off-mode Approach Mining
title_zh: ROAM-GRPO：通过路由式非主流解法挖掘提升 GRPO 的推理多样性
abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) paired with Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become the dominant recipe for post-training LLMs on complex reasoning tasks, but has been shown to collapse the policy into a low-diversity mode. Repeated LLM outputs are nearly identical, and pass@k accuracy converges or degrades as a result. We propose ROAM-GRPO (Routed Off-mode Approach Mining for GRPO), an augmentation to the GRPO algorithm which incentivizes exploration of distinct reasoning strategies and aims to increase output creativity during evaluation. ROAM-GRPO detects well-solved problems during training and transfers them to an "off-mode" track. The model is prompted to produce distinct solution strategies to such problems, which are verified for logical validity and distinctness by an LLM judge and subsequently self-distilled into the policy. Training Qwen3.5-2b on a 1,000-problem subset of the MATH lvl5 dataset, ROAM-GRPO implementation increases peak pass@16 by 4.7% and correct embedding cosine distance by approximately 1.5-2x on a difficult evaluation set.
abstract_zh: 监督微调（SFT）结合可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）是大语言模型复杂推理任务的主流后训练方案，但可能使策略坍缩到低多样性模式。模型多次采样得到的输出几乎相同，导致 pass@k 随采样次数增加而趋于饱和，甚至下降。为此，论文提出 ROAM-GRPO（Routed Off-mode Approach Mining for GRPO）来扩展 GRPO：训练时识别模型已能较好解决的问题，将其分流至非主流解法（off-mode）轨道，引导模型生成不同的解题策略，再由 LLM 评审验证解法的逻辑有效性和差异性，并通过自蒸馏将通过验证的解法融入策略。在 MATH lvl5 的 1,000 道题上训练 Qwen3.5-2b 后，该方法在高难度评估集上的峰值 pass@16 提升 4.7%，正确解答之间的嵌入余弦距离达到原来的约 1.5–2 倍。
key_points_zh: SFT 与 RLVR 可能使模型反复生成近乎相同的解法，削弱多次采样带来的收益。
ROAM-GRPO 将模型已能较好解决的题目分流到 off-mode 轨道，引导模型探索不同解题策略。
LLM 评审同时检查解法的逻辑有效性和差异性；通过验证的解法用于自蒸馏。
在 Qwen3.5-2b 的实验中，高难度评估集上的峰值 pass@16 提升 4.7%，正确解答之间的嵌入余弦距离达到原来的约 1.5–2 倍。
